settings.name: shipping_flat_rate
settings.description: The flat shipping charge for an order that needs sending, in the smallest unit of the currency (500 is 5.00). 0 is free shipping. A product can set its own charge

settings.name: flat_rate_enabled
settings.description: Whether an order that boxes and carriers cannot price pays the flat rate. When off, such an order cannot be placed

settings.name: shipping_countries
settings.description: The countries physical items ship to, as two-letter codes separated by commas. Blank ships nowhere

settings.name: weight_unit
settings.description: The unit product weights are measured in: oz, lb, g or kg

settings.name: dimension_unit
settings.description: The unit product lengths, widths and heights are measured in: in or cm

settings.name: processing_count_weekends
settings.description: Whether weekends count towards processing days (the days it takes to make a product and get it ready to ship)

settings.name: processing_cutoff
settings.description: The time of day (HH:MM, 24 hour) after which today no longer counts towards processing days. Blank for none

settings.name: processing_timezone
settings.description: The time zone the order cutoff time is in

settings.name: combine_items
settings.description: Whether items in an order are put into one box where they fit, instead of one box each

settings.name: origin_name
settings.description: The name or business orders are sent from, which carriers need to quote a rate

settings.name: origin_phone
settings.description: The phone number orders are sent from

settings.name: origin_line1
settings.description: The street address orders are sent from

settings.name: origin_line2
settings.description: The apartment, suite or unit orders are sent from

settings.name: origin_city
settings.description: The city orders are sent from

settings.name: origin_state
settings.description: The state or region orders are sent from

settings.name: origin_postal_code
settings.description: The postal code orders are sent from

settings.name: origin_country
settings.description: The country orders are sent from, as a two-letter code

permissions.name: shipping:view
permissions.description: See the shipping settings: the flat rate and the countries shipped to

groups.name: kempo-shipping:viewer
groups.description: Can see the shipping settings, but not change them
